title: Zero-sum triples in {±1,…,±m}∖{±b}: the case 3 | b (note, Lean 4 formalization and verification code)
description: Lemma B: for m ≡ 1 (mod 3) and 1 ≤ b ≤ m, {±1,…,±m}∖{±b} can be partitioned into zero-sum triples, except (m,b) ∈ {(4,1),(4,3),(7,1)}. The new case is 3 | b. The statement for m ≥ 10 is formally verified in Lean 4/Mathlib (theorem LemaB.lemmaB, standard axioms only). Includes the note (LaTeX/PDF), the Lean development and an independent Python verifier. Produced with substantial AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic); see the note.
